Functional parity with the checker matters more than superficial differences . Output JSON.

Existing playbook:
ACE Playbook Insights
Use these distilled reminders to plan tool usage. Keep tool calls faithful to the functions provided in the BFCL benchmark.

message_api
- delta1: When user provides their own ID, send confirmation message back to them immediately.
- delta2: User ID disclosure triggers send_message to that user immediately, using provided IDs directly without validation
- delta3: Continue message operations across all conversation turns regardless of user input brevity.
- delta4: Execute message_login and send_message directly when user IDs are explicitly provided, without additional validation calls

vehicle_control_api
- delta1: Always press brake pedal before attempting engine start - safety requirement
- delta10: Avoid redundant tire pressure checks when already performed in same conversation context
- delta2: Only recommend tire shops when pressure is actually below specified threshold
- delta3: Execute fillFuelTank once with precise calculation - avoid multiple calls or redundant feasibility checks that create state drift
- delta4: Complete all vehicle start sequence operations when engine start is requested - lock doors and press brake pedal before single start attempt
- delta5: Avoid redundant status checks that don't advance vehicle state in multi-turn scenarios
- delta6: Execute engine start sequence only once with proper brake pedal application - avoid redundant start attempts
- delta7: Call estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage only once per trip planning scenario - avoid redundant feasibility checks
- delta8: Include set_navigation when destination is specified in trip planning context
- delta9: Lock all doors before attempting engine start - safety requirement to prevent unauthorized access
